svg.title: AgentHQ: the living office for your local AI team
svg.desc: Illustration: a pixel-art office at night. Seven agents sit at desks with glowing monitors, a task corkboard hangs on the wall, a tuxedo cat walks across the floor and a round orange cat sleeps in the corner.
svg.text: The living office for your local AI team.
Seven agents, two cats, real telemetry.
